seoTitle: Best Free App to Bulk Edit Prices on Shopify
metaDescription: Use a free bulk price editor app on Shopify to increase or decrease product prices by percentage across your entire catalog fast.
intro: Editing prices one product at a time is a slow way to run a sale or adjust for cost changes across a large catalog. This guide covers how to use a free bulk price editor app on Shopify to update prices for all products or selected collections at once.

steps.heading: Install a bulk price editor app
steps.body: Search the Shopify App Store for a free bulk price editing app and install it on your store.

steps.heading: Select the products to update
steps.body: Choose whether to apply changes to your entire catalog or a specific collection of products.

steps.heading: Set your price adjustment
steps.body: Increase or decrease prices by a percentage or fixed amount, depending on what the app supports.

steps.heading: Preview changes before applying
steps.body: Review the calculated new prices to make sure they're correct before confirming the bulk update.

steps.heading: Apply and verify
steps.body: Run the bulk edit and spot-check a few products afterward to confirm prices updated as expected.

faq.question: Can I undo a bulk price change if I make a mistake?
faq.answer: Many bulk editor apps keep a history or backup of previous prices, letting you revert changes, but it's worth checking your chosen app's specific feature set.

faq.question: Will bulk editing affect sale or compare-at prices too?
faq.answer: This depends on the app — some let you adjust both regular and compare-at prices, while others only touch the main price field.

faq.question: Is a free bulk price editor limited in how many products it can update?
faq.answer: Free plans on many apps do cap the number of products or edits per month, so check the app's limits if you have a large catalog.

faq.question: Can I apply price changes to just one collection instead of the whole store?
faq.answer: Yes, most bulk editing apps let you filter by collection so you can target specific groups of products rather than your entire catalog.
